chunks: Sulaym ibn Qays al-Hilali narrated, from Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari and Abdullah ibn Abbas, who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said in his bequest to the Commander of the Faithful: 'O my brother, indeed Quraish will overpower you and their unity will be upon your oppression and subjugation; so if you find helpers, strive against them, and if you do not find helpers, restrain your hand and preserve your blood, for indeed martyrdom is behind you.'

key_terms.قُرَيْشٌ: Quraish, the dominant tribe of Mecca

ai.seo_question: What was the Prophet's advice to Ali regarding fighting Quraish?
ai.summary: Recorded by the early traditionist Sulaym ibn Qays al-Halali, this hadith highlights the Prophet’s (SAWW) strategic foresight regarding the political pressure from Quraish, advising Ali (AS) to exercise tactical patience (hilm) to preserve his life for the eventual divine victory. It underscores the Shia principle that martyrdom is a guaranteed outcome but should not be sought prematurely if it jeopardizes the broader mission, a key theme in the narrative of the Imamate's continuity.
